{{nihongo|'''Kamo Shrine'''|加毛神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Kamo Shrine''' (かもじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}{{ill|Anpachi District, Gifu|ceb|Ampachi-gun|es|Distrito de Anpachi (Gifu)|fa|شهرستان آنپاچی، گیفو|fr|District d'Anpachi|id|Distrik Anpachi, Gifu|it|Distretto di Anpachi|ja|安八郡|ko|안파치군|pl|Powiat Anpachi|pt|Distrito de Anpachi|uk|Повіт Ампаті|vi|Anpachi (huyện)|zh|安八郡|qid=Q1204320}}{{ill|Wanouchi, Gifu|arz|وانوتشى|ceb|Wanouchi-chō|es|Wanouchi (Gifu)|fa|وانوئوچی، گیفو|fr|Wanouchi|it|Wanouchi|ja|輪之内町|ko|와노우치정|ms|Wanouchi, Gifu|my|ဝနိုအုချိမြို့၊ ဂိဖု|pl|Wanouchi|ru|Ваноути|tl|Wanouchi, Gifu|tr|Wanouchi|uk|Ваноуті|ur|وانوچی، گیفو|zh|輪之內町|qid=Q1204291}}.

It is the Kamo Shrine of Anpachi District in {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and is considered one of the {{ill|Kamo Shrine (disambiguation)|Q11398885|qid=Q11398885}} (Kamo Shrine / Kamo Shrine) found throughout Japan.

=== History and Overview ===
The date of founding is unknown. It is said that {{ill|Kami Ōne|ja|神大根王|qid=Q119380336}} (son of {{ill|Hikoimasu no Ōkimi|ja|彦坐王|ko|히코이마스노미코|zh|彥坐王|qid=Q11487910}}; ancestor of the {{ill|Motosu no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|本巣国造|qid=Q11520234}} and {{ill|Mino no Saki no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|三野前国造|qid=Q11358204}}) or his descendants enshrined their ancestral deity, Kambe Wakareikazuchi no Mikoto, when they cultivated this land.<ref name="岐阜県神社庁">[https://www.gifu-jinjacho.jp/syosai.php?shrno=64&shrname=%E2%98%85%E5%8A%A0%E6%AF%9B%E7%A5%9E%E7%A4%BE%E2%98%85 Kamo Shrine (Gifu Prefectural Association of Shinto Shrines)]</ref>.

The original name at the time of founding was Kamo Shrine (in the Mino Province Jinmyōchō it appears as “Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade Kamo Myōjin”<ref name="岐阜県神社庁"/><ref name="加毛神社"/>), but from around the {{ill|Kamakura period|Q236205|qid=Q236205}} it became a shrine enshrining {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|Q3090037|qid=Q3090037|lt=Shirahige Daimyōjin}} and was renamed Shirahige Shrine. For this reason, some documents still list the enshrined deity as “Shirahige Daimyōjin.”

In {{ill|1869|Q7720|qid=Q7720}} (Meiji 2), it was renamed Kamo Shrine, and in {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6) it was designated a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.<ref name="岐阜県神社庁"/><ref name="かんこう輪之内">{{Cite web|language=Japanese|url=https://kanko.washoko.or.jp/detail.php?id=24|title=Kamo Shrine|publisher=Wanouchi Town Chamber of Commerce and Industry|accessdate=2025-11-14}}</ref>

=== Enshrined Deity ===
* {{ill|Kamo-wake-ikazuchi-no-Kami|Q11634943|qid=Q11634943|lt=Kambe Wakareikazuchi no Mikoto}}
: There is also a theory that the deity is {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|Q3090037|qid=Q3090037|lt=Shirahige Daimyōjin}}.

=== Major Festivals ===
* Ganshi-sai – January 3
* {{ill|Sagichō Fire Festival|ja|左義長|pl|Sagichō|qid=Q9332740}} – Second Sunday of January
* Kayutsuke Shinji – The day after Sagichō
* Kinen-sai – First Sunday of March
* Annual Festival – September 30
* Parishioners’ Thanksgiving Festival (Kamo Shrine Festival) – Second Sunday of October

=== Location ===
* 13017 Shimōgure Higashi-ise, Wanouchi Town, Anpachi District, Gifu Prefecture
: On the right bank of the {{ill|Ōgure River|Q11436448|qid=Q11436448}} (a tributary of the {{ill|Nagara River|Q1194094|qid=Q1194094}}), in the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Fukutsuka Wajū}}
